subject: Re: Pilot credits, commit tiers, and launch incentive — NimbleHealth
body:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@nimblehealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: sam.cho@nimblehealth.com
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot ask + long-term commit question

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency profile looked promising. Our engineering lead wants to run a 6-week POC to validate throughput at peak concurrency and output-quality on clinical summarization. Two quick asks from procurement/product:

- Can Redwood provide $25k in pilot credits we can draw against hosted API usage during the POC?
- If the POC is successful, NimbleHealth is prepared to discuss a 12-month commit. What volume-based per-token discount tiers do you offer for committed monthly usage? We expect the ramp to be ~50M tokens/month by month 6.

Also attach our standard PO template to start redlining procurement.

Best,
Elaine
Director of Partnerships, NimbleHealth

---

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Elaine Park <elaine@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot ask + long-term commit question

Hi Elaine — great to connect. Appreciate the clear asks. High level proposal from our side: 

1) Pilot credits: we can provide $20k in hosted API credits for a time-boxed 6-week POC. In exchange we ask for a short success checklist (quality thresholds and perf SLOs) and a mutual action plan document.

2) Commit tiers (12mo term) — ballpark per-token discounts off list (example):
   - 0–50M tokens/month: list price (no commit discount)
   - 50M–200M tokens/month: 10% off per-token
   - 200M–500M tokens/month: 18% off per-token
   - 500M+ tokens/month: custom pricing (native sales + engineering review)

3) Launch incentive: If NimbleHealth signs a 12mo commit and reaches the 50M tokens/month V1 threshold within the first 90 days after go-live, we can provide an onboarding credit of $50k (applied to first invoice) and a one-time volume rebate of 5% on any overage in months 4–6.

Notes/constraints: Pilot credits are non-refundable and only apply to hosted API usage. Deeper discounts (beyond the table above) require finance approval and a minimum committed spend.

I'll attach a short pilot scope template and our standard launch-incentive summary. If this looks directionally right I can loop in RevOps for an approval path for the additional $5k to meet your $25k ask.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: pilot-scope.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-launch-incentive.pdf

---

From: Sam Cho <sam.cho@nimblehealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine@nimblehealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot ask + long-term commit question

Karthik — thanks. Two clarifying points from product/procurement: 

- The POC checklist: can you provide a short template that maps to perf SLOs (p95 latency < 250ms for summarized docs, 99.9% availability for requests) and an expected token accounting method?
- For the commit tiers: our legal team prefers discounts expressed as a per-token price rather than percent off list. Can you supply an example per-token rate for the 50M and 200M breakpoints? Also, can the onboarding credit be structured as a one-time bill credit rather than applied to the first invoice to simplify accounting?

Sam
VP Product, NimbleHealth

---

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine@nimblehealth.com>, Sam Cho <sam.cho@nimblehealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: internal: approval request for additional pilot credit and sample per-token rates

Karthik / Rishi — looping you both in to coordinate. Proposed changes to offer to NimbleHealth to keep momentum:

- Topline: approve additional $5k to meet their $25k pilot request (total $25k time-boxed credits) subject to a signed mutual action plan and PO. This can be categorized as sales marketing credits for Q4.
- Per-token examples to share with legal (list price assumed $0.00003 per token for text-gen):
   - 50M tokens/month -> $0.000027 per token (10% discount) => monthly committed spend = $1,350
   - 200M tokens/month -> $0.0000246 per token (18% discount) => monthly committed spend = $4,920
- Onboarding credit: convert to a one-time bill credit of $50k applied after first invoice, payable within the first billing cycle.

Rishi — do we need any finance sign-off beyond this? If not, I can confirm to NimbleHealth and get the mutual action plan signed.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

---

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine@nimblehealth.com>, Sam Cho <sam.cho@nimblehealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: internal: approval request for additional pilot credit and sample per-token rates

Laura — finance ok to approve the extra $5k pilot credit (total $25k) and the example per-token list below, provided we get:

1) A signed PO referencing DEAL-8907 and the mutual action plan (MAP)
2) Payment terms: Net 30 after pilot conversion; unused credits will expire at the end of the POC window
3) A clause stating that deeper discounts require a signed committed spend schedule and 30 days notice for quantization/engine changes that materially affect unit economics

Once you confirm I'll ask legal to prep a simple amendment template for the PO.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

---

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Elaine Park <elaine@nimblehealth.com>, Sam Cho <sam.cho@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-22T16:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot ask + long-term commit question

Hi Elaine / Sam — quick update and next steps: 

- Pilot credits: Redwood will provide $25k in time-boxed hosted API credits for the 6-week POC. Credits expire 7 days after the POC end date.
- Per-token example rates (list price $0.00003/token):
   • 50M tokens/month: $0.000027/token (monthly committed spend ≈ $1,350)
   • 200M tokens/month: $0.0000246/token (monthly committed spend ≈ $4,920)
- Onboarding credit: $50k one-time bill credit to be applied after the first invoice if NimbleHealth signs a 12mo commit and hits 50M tokens/month within 90 days of go-live.
- Contract mechanics: Need signed PO + MAP referencing DEAL-8907. Payment terms Net 30 after conversion.

Action items:
1) Elaine — please send the redlined PO (or confirm acceptance of our standard amendment).
2) Karthik / Laura / Rishi (internal) — I'll prepare the MAP and DocuSign link for the amendment.

I'll circulate the DocuSign when legal confirms the amendment. Thanks — excited to get this running.

Best,
Karthik
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
